decision.reasoning_trace: I narrowed my focus to products that were actual speakers rather than accessories like cases or charging cables. My consideration set included highly-rated portable speakers with good power-to-price ratios. The EDUPLINK (prod_bluetooth_speakers_051) and Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) were strong contenders for budget-conscious buyers, while the Bose (prod_bluetooth_speakers_071) offered brand reliability. The BOGASING (prod_bluetooth_speakers_174) provided the highest wattage (40W) in the mid-range. Ultimately, I chose the Raymate Bluetooth Speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) because it is designated as the 'Overall Pick' with a high 4.6 rating, 30W output, and a very competitive price of $39.99, offering the best balance of performance and value.
